lists.content:
• Manage, grow and own a portfolio of client accounts across global markets, ensuring strong day-to-day coverage and follow-up.
  • Be 100% accountable of results obtained within your portfolio.
  • Build and maintain positive client relationships by understanding their needs and coordinating timely solutions.
  • Identify opportunities to upsell and cross-sell additional products and services, working closely with the Sales and Partnerships teams.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support the successful delivery of dLocal’s solutions and resolve operational or commercial matters.
  • Monitor account performance, prepare relevant updates and help identify opportunities to improve client experience and business results.
  • Develop a solid understanding of the payments industry and the markets relevant to the assigned portfolio.
  • Support account plans, business reviews and other initiatives aimed at driving client retention and growth.
  • Drive client meetings, QBRs, industry events and professional networking activities as needed.

• 2+ years of experience in account management, sales, customer success or a related commercial role, preferably in a technology, payments or fintech company.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work effectively with different stakeholders.
  • Commercial mindset and interest in identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize multiple accounts, projects and deadlines with attention to detail.
  • Analytical approach and willingness to use data to understand account performance and support decision-making.
  • Proactive, collaborative and customer-oriented attitude, with a willingness to learn and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
  • Fluency in English is required; other languages are a plus.
  • Ability and willingness to travel internationally when needed.
